title: Knowledge Management & Training Specialist, Trust & Safety Ops
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

As a Knowledge & Training Specialist, you will support operational teams by developing knowledge and learning solutions that help people perform effectively, adapt to change, and confidently apply operational processes in their day-to-day work.

Depending on business needs and your assigned focus area, your responsibilities may lean more toward knowledge management, operational enablement, or learning and development. You will work across the full knowledge lifecycle: identifying needs, developing solutions, supporting implementation, and continuously improving knowledge and learning experiences based on operational insights and stakeholder feedback.

This role is well-suited to an independent, proactive specialist who enjoys solving problems, collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders, and driving improvements that positively impact operational performance.

We are currently looking for several Knowledge Management & Training Specialists to join our Commercial Policy & Catalog, Brand Authentication, and Risk & Policy KMT teams.

The Commercial Policy & Catalog KMT team focuses on managing and developing knowledge and training related to commercial policies and catalog processes, ensuring specialists have the expertise and resources needed to make accurate decisions.

The Brand Authentication KMT team focuses on managing brand-related knowledge and training, ensuring specialists have the expertise and resources needed to make accurate decisions.

The Risk & Policy KMT team focuses on onboarding and continuous training, as well as developing and driving training initiatives related to policies, processes, and operational changes.

In this position, you’ll 

• Identify knowledge, learning, and communication needs by analysing operational challenges, business changes, stakeholder feedback, and performance insights.

• Design, develop, and continuously improve knowledge and learning solutions that support onboarding, capability building, operational readiness, and continuous learning.

• Support the implementation of process, policy, and business changes by ensuring teams have the knowledge and resources needed to adapt successfully.

• Collaborate with SMEs, Quality, Operations, partner teams, and other stakeholders to gather requirements, validate solutions, and align priorities.

• Drive assigned initiatives from planning through implementation by coordinating stakeholders, managing dependencies, and ensuring agreed actions are delivered.

title: AI/ML Engineering Intern
description:
Location: Remote (United States)
Work Model: Remote
Industry: AI recruiting and talent marketplace (B2B SaaS)
Compensation: $35-$50 per hour
About the Company
TalentPluto is a Y Combinator-backed startup building the hiring stack for high-growth companies. We run two connected products: a talent network that places engineering, go-to-market, and operations people into fast-moving startups, and an AI recruiting tool that lets a hiring team run candidate search, tiered enrichment, rubric-based scoring, and outbound campaigns directly from their assistant. We work with dozens of venture-backed startups across AI, developer tools, fintech, and healthcare. The team is small and founder-led, and interns work on live problems rather than practice ones.
The Opportunity
This is an applied AI internship inside a product where the model output is the product. We use LLMs to read unstructured professional histories, extract structure from them, score candidates against a role, and rank what a recruiter sees first. Every one of those steps can be confidently wrong, so the interesting work is as much about evaluating quality as it is about building the pipeline.
You will work on real LLM workflows against messy data at volume: designing prompts and extraction logic, building the evaluations that tell you whether a change actually helped, and improving ranking and retrieval where the current answer is not good enough. This is applied rather than research work, and you will be able to see the effect of what you build on what real users get.
Responsibilities

• Build and improve LLM workflows for extraction, scoring, and ranking against real product data.

• Design evaluations that measure output quality, and use them to judge whether a change is an improvement.

• Work with messy, high-volume unstructured data and turn it into reliable structure.

• Improve retrieval and ranking so the most relevant results surface first.

• Investigate incorrect or low-quality output and trace it back to its cause.

Requirements

• Strong programming fundamentals in Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, or a similar language.

• Interest in applied AI, machine learning, LLMs, ranking, retrieval, or data systems.

• Comfort working with messy data and evaluating output quality.

• Has built AI/ML, data, class, research, or side projects.

• Strong problem-solving ability and a willingness to learn quickly.

• Clear communicator who can work independently in a remote environment.

- Strong analytical ability and structured thinking, with clear, credible communication to senior stakeholders.

- Coachability and humility - growth-minded, open to feedback, and comfortable operating in a fast-evolving environment with limited structure.

- Genuine interest in the legal industry and a commitment to enhancing knowledge work through technology.

- Familiarity with sales practices in the ANZ region is a plus.

- Location: Sydney, NSW (hybrid - 3 days in the Sydney office, 2 days working from home).

What we offer

- The chance to be a founding member of our Sydney team and help build a new segment.

- A structured hybrid working arrangement.

- Enterprise-level exposure and a clear path to progress toward an Enterprise AE role.

title: Senior Engineer - Hyperscale Analytics

About the Role

We are seeking exceptional Senior Engineer- Hyperscale Analytics to design and scale next-generation data processing and analytics platforms that power OLTP, OLAP, and large-scale distributed data systems. You will build and optimize pipelines and services that handle billions of records daily, enabling real-time transactions, analytical insights, and AI-driven decisioning.

What You’ll Do

• Transactional & Analytical Systems: Design and implement highly scalable OLTP systems for real-time workloads and OLAP systems for complex analytical queries on massive datasets

• Collaboration: Partner with data scientists, ML engineers, and product teams to build unified, secure, and cost-efficient data platforms

What You’ll Bring

• 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a significant portion focused on data infrastructure, distributed systems, or large-scale analytics platforms

• Deep experience with distributed data processing frameworks (e.g., Spark, Flink, or similar)

• Strong background in cloud-scale data architecture (AWS, Azure, or GCP) - data lakes, warehouses, streaming platforms

• Proficiency in one or more of: Python, Java, Scala, or Go

• Experience with modern data warehouse/lakehouse technologies (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift)

• Solid understanding of data modeling, ETL/ELT design, and pipeline orchestration (e.g., Airflow, dbt)

• Track record of designing for scale, reliability, and cost efficiency in production systems

Bonus Skills

• Experience with HTAP (Hybrid Transactional/Analytical Processing) systems or real-time analytics platforms

• Familiarity with data lakehouse architectures and formats like Parquet, ORC, Delta, Iceberg, Hudi

• Knowledge of containerized deployments (Docker, Kubernetes) and cloud-native data architectures (AWS Redshift, GCP BigQuery, Azure Synapse)

• Background in query engine development or contributing to open-source OLAP/OLTP frameworks

 
What you'll get

• Paid parental leave: 8 weeks for all parents, 16 weeks for birthing parents

• Medical, dental, and vision coverage starting on your first day

• 401(k) retirement plan with company matching contributions

• Fertility, adoption, and surrogacy support through Maven, plus paid volunteer time

•
Own the agentic development environment: Ensure agents can operate in independent cloud-based development environments, execute our full test suites, examine build results visually, etc

•
Documentation and context: Own our repo-wide file and work with teams to ensure our library of agent guidance and skills is continually pushing the bar. Ensure our conventions and package structures are exposed in ways that agents can effectively use

•
Enablement: Work with our engineers to understand where agents are struggling and address root causes such as better docs, tooling access, etc. Develop tooling for non-engineers to make simple visual updates to our application

•
Serve as a “PM” for internal AI agents: Consistently keep us on the leading edge of AI productivity trends by staying abreast of what is state-of-the-art in industry and driving those improvements across Hightouch

We are looking for talented, intellectually curious, and motivated individuals who are interested in tackling the problems above. The salary range for this position is $180,000 - $400,000 USD per year, which is location independent in accordance with our remote-first policy. The Complex Business Travel Sales Manager is responsible for driving revenue growth from established and new business travel accounts across assigned hotel properties. This role manages contracted transient business, identifies and activates new revenue opportunities, and increases market share within each hotel’s competitive set. Responsibilities:

title: Účetní Analytik/čka (Accountant/RTR)
description:
Do našeho Group Finance Centre hledáme GL / RTR Accountant, který se bude starat o účetní agendu v rámci procesu Record to Report pro Rohlik Group a související společnosti.
Čeká tě práce na měsíčních závěrkách, účetních zápisech a odsouhlasování účtů napříč více entitami. Zároveň hledáme někoho, kdo nechce jen mechanicky zpracovávat účetnictví, ale všímá si, kde můžeme procesy dělat jednodušeji, rychleji a efektivněji.

Proč je tahle role zajímavá

- Dostaneš se k účetnictví napříč více společnostmi Rohlik Group, ne jen k jedné lokální entitě.

- Budeš součástí celého RTR procesu a získáš širší zkušenost s účetními závěrkami a reportingovým cyklem.

- Vedle každodenní účetní agendy se zapojíš také do zlepšování a nastavování procesů.

- Budeš spolupracovat s kolegy napříč Finance týmy a postupně si budovat hlubší znalost fungování Group Finance.

- Je to dobrá příležitost pro někoho, kdo už má první účetní zkušenosti a chce se dál profesně posouvat.

Co tě u nás čeká

- Zodpovědnost za svěřenou část procesu měsíční účetní závěrky

- Zpracování pravidelných účetních zápisů (Journal Vouchers)

- Práce podle uzávěrkového kalendáře napříč více entitami

- Kontrola včasnosti a kvality odsouhlasení účtů

- Samostatné řešení běžných a opakujících se účetních úkolů

- Řešení známých účetních problémů ve spolupráci s Group Accounting Managerem

- Spolupráce s dalšími Finance týmy napříč skupinou

- Zapojení do nastavování KPI a performance managementu

- Hledání příležitostí ke zjednodušení, standardizaci a zvýšení efektivity RTR procesů

Co od tebe očekáváme

- 1-2 roky praktických zkušeností v oblasti českého účetnictví nebo financí

- Dobrou znalost základních účetních principů

- Studium nebo dokončené vzdělání v oblasti Business Administration, účetnictví, financí nebo podobném oboru

- Zkušenost nebo zájem o zlepšování účetních procesů

- Pečlivost, dobrou organizaci práce a schopnost dodržovat termíny

- Dobré komunikační schopnosti a chuť spolupracovat s kolegy napříč týmy

- Češtinu plynně (nutnost) a Angličtinu na pokročilé úrovni, kterou zvládneš používat každý den v psané i mluvené komunikaci

-

Co z toho budeš mít

- Férovou odměnu - Dostaneš atraktivní fixní mzdu - bez bonusových her a politiky. Dobrá práce si zaslouží jasné a férové uznání.

- Dobré jídlo každý den - Každý den si můžeš dát oběd zdarma a v kanceláři tě čeká čerstvé ovoce a zelenina. Protože dobré jídlo dělá dobrou práci.

- Život, nejen práce - Skutečná flexibilita - tři dny v kanceláři, 2 dny Home Office. A ano, máme i neomezenou placenou dovolenou založenou na důvěře.

- Osobní růst - Porosteš stejně rychle jako Rohlík. Každá výzva je příležitost naučit se něco nového a zanechat stopu.

- Reálný dopad - To, co děláš, má smysl. Uvidíš, jak tvoje práce mění způsob, jakým lidé jedí a žijí - od prvního dne.

- Uznání mezi kolegy - Tvoje úsilí nezůstane bez povšimnutí. Můžeš ocenit ostatní (a být oceněn) díky peer kreditům, které využiješ v naší interní „kavárně“.

- Xtra členství - Získáš členství Xtra zdarma a 10% cashback na všechny nákupy na Rohlik.cz http://Rohlik.cz.

- Sport a wellbeing - Zůstaneš v pohybu díky firemním sportovním výzvám nebo dotované Multisport kartě.

- Tým, který drží při sobě - Budeš pracovat s lidmi, kteří jedou naplno, navzájem se podporují a společně slaví úspěchy.

- Zní to jako ty? - Jsi člověk, který bere věci do vlastních rukou, jedná rychle a dotahuje věci do konce?

- Tak pojď s námi „upéct“ něco skvělého.

title: Clinical Investigator Behavioral Health
description:
Position Purpose: Conduct comprehensive reviews of medical records and documents supporting claims for providers, suppliers, and pharmacies to include but not limited to physicians, inpatient, outpatient, ancillary, behavioral health care, laboratory, etc. Provides investigative support to the Special Investigations Unit (SIU) related to coding and billing issues and identifies potential overpayments and suspected health care fraud and abuse. Position requires the associate to verify authorization for services and written documentation of services provided against claim information, ensure the appropriateness and accuracy of diagnosis and procedure codes supporting such claims, coordinate medical necessity and appropriate level of care determinations with Medical Directors, and validate services against CMS and State-specific coverage, limitations and exclusion guidelines. Coordinate with internal and external resources in determining the appropriateness of codes found in administrative, medical, claim and financial records, develop reports of findings and recommendations, communicate complex results of audit findings in meetings and/or judicial hearings, and assist SIU investigators during interviews, discussions and negotiations with providers, suppliers, and pharmacies.
Key Details: Candidates must be fully licensed with one of the approved licenses listed below upon the submission of the Centene application. One of the following Behavioral Health licenses is required - LMHC, LCSW, LMFT, LPC, LMHP, or LIMHP

• Perform retrospective and prepayment reviews of medical records to identify potential fraud, waste, and abuse and inappropriate billing practices.

• Investigate, analyze, and identify provider billing patterns to determine payment based on medical records, claim history, billing codes, regulatory and state guidelines, and policies.

• Prepare summary of findings and recommend next steps for providers.

• Identify preventative measures and recommend changes to internal policies and procedures and/or provider practices to prevent future fraudulent and erroneous practices.

• Collaborate with investigators to identify abuse and fraud by utilizing clinical and coding expertise to analyze patterns in billing activities.

• Performs other duties as assigned

• Complies with all policies and standards

Education/Experience: Master’s Degree and 2 + years of direct board clinical behavioral health experience with a fully independent clinical license AND 2+ years of fraud, waste, and abuse experience is required. A Certified Professional Coder (CPC) certification is preferred but not required.
Preferred Experience:
·2+ years of experience in state agency investigations, special investigations in managed care, behavioral health provider reviews, medical record reviews, behavioral health billing/coding analysis, or behavioral health compliance.
·3+ years of providing direct Psychotherapy or Inpatient group therapy within inpatient psychiatric hospitals or units, residential treatment centers, substance abuse rehabilitation facilities, military or veteran hospitals
· Direct experience or working knowledge with FWA policies in state agency investigations or managed care investigations is preferred
·Strong clinical documentation and problem-solving skills required
·Role requires openness, adaptability, and flexibility for business changes
·Strong communication, attention to detail, organizational and time management skills are required
·Skilled at utilizing Microsoft Office applications (MS 365 Co-Pilot, Excel, Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, OneNote, Teams) and is open to utilizing Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, etc) is preferred

Běžný sklad je minulost. V našem distribučním centru stavíme budoucnost logistiky - a ty u toho můžeš být v první linii. Spouštíme unikatní pilotní projekt, kde spojením lidské zručnosti a špičkové technologie učímé AI a robotické systémy chápata zvládát reálnou práci ve skladu.

Jako Picking Robot Trainer se staneš živým vzorem pro zítřejší roboty. Vybavíme tě chytrou nositelnou technologií - kamerami na hlavě a na zápěstí nebo senzory pohybu - a tvůj každodenní skvělý výkon na skladě poslouží jako tréninková data pro vývoj budoucích automatizovaných systémů a optimalizaci ergonomie.

Nejedná se o úkol navíc k běžnému pickování, ale o plně samostatnou a klíčovou roli. Kvalita budoucí automatizace totiž závisí výhradně na tom, jak přesně a konzistentně svou práci odvádíš.

Co bude náplní práce?

- Standardní pickování: Výběr zboží na přidělené linii (potraviny, pečivo, oversize aj.) přesně podle SOP a v běžném tempu.

- Správa nahrávací techniky: Příprava, kontrola a používání nositelných kamer (hlava/zápěstí), případně senzomotorických rukavic.

- Dohled nad záznamem: Výměna baterií během přestávek, kontrola plynulosti nahrávání a hlášení výpadků.

- Práce od pondělí do pátku na 8 hodinové směny

Co očekáváme?

- Praxi v pickování: Zkušenost s pickováním se stabilním výkony a vysokou kvalitou.

- Preciznost a spolehlivost: Důsledné a přesné dodržování postupů (SOP).

- Jazyk a technologie: Plynulou češtinu a základní uživatelskou znalost práce s Smartphone/tabletem.

Co ti nabízíme?

- Rohlík Xtra účet zdarma - nakupování s 10% cashbackem v podobě kreditů na další nákupy.

- Možnost placeného volna - čas na pořádný odpočinek a regeneraci.

- Dotované obědy & občerstvení zdarma - dobré jídlo, skvělá káva a čerstvé ovoce přímo na pracovišti každý den.

- Systém odměn za pochvaly - sbírání hvězdiček od kolegů a jejich výměna za vouchery do Alzy, Notina a dalších e-shopů.

- Multisport karta - příspěvek na sport i zasloužený relax po práci.

- Fajn firemní akce - společné oslavy úspěchů a neformální večeře či večírky.

title: Operating Systems Engineer, Connectivity & Networking | Consumer Devices
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

OpenAI Consumer Devices is building the next generation of products that bring powerful AI into people’s everyday lives. Guided by OpenAI’s mission to ensure AGI benefits all of humanity, our team combines world-class researchers, engineers, designers, and operators who care deeply about creating useful, intuitive, and responsible technology. You’ll have the opportunity to work alongside exceptional people on ambitious, zero-to-one challenges at the intersection of hardware, software, and AI. This is a chance to help define an entirely new category of products-and shape how people experience AI in the future.

Our team works across systems software and product engineering to build reliable consumer devices and the platforms behind them. We develop the connectivity and networking foundations that support communication across OpenAI products and systems.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As an Operating Systems Engineer focused on connectivity and networking, you will design, develop, and maintain the OS capabilities that enable reliable, secure, and efficient communication across OpenAI products and systems.

Your work will span Wi-Fi and Bluetooth frameworks, IP networking, and advanced network services and policy. You’ll develop OS services, libraries, and interfaces for a broad range of connectivity needs, make design decisions across software boundaries, and carry solutions through development, integration, and production.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

- Build connectivity foundations: Design, implement, and maintain OS services, frameworks, and APIs for Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and IP networking.

- Develop reusable network capabilities: Build connection management, network configuration and selection, service discovery, and routing capabilities.

- Enable secure communication: Develop network services and policies for secure communication, traffic management, and isolation across varied network environments.

- Resolve issues across the stack: Investigate correctness, concurrency, interoperability, and reliability issues across OS components, protocol stacks, and application interfaces.

- Improve performance and efficiency: Use tracing, profiling, and repeatable measurements to improve latency, throughput, resource use, and power efficiency.

- Validate real-world reliability: Build diagnostic tools, representative workloads, and automated tests to validate interoperability and failure recovery across changing network and operating conditions, measure reliability improvements, and protect gains with regression coverage.

- Deliver maintainable product capabilities: Partner with hardware, firmware, security, platform, and application engineers to translate system requirements into shipped capabilities and clear, maintainable interfaces for integration and troubleshooting.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

- Substantial hands-on experience developing Wi-Fi and Bluetooth functionality in operating-system frameworks, system services, or connectivity middleware.

- Strong understanding of IP networking, including IPv4/IPv6, TCP/UDP, DNS, DHCP, routing, and socket behavior, with practical experience implementing and debugging networked systems.

- Experience implementing advanced networking capabilities in one or more areas such as routing and network policy, VPNs and tunneling, traffic management, or network isolation.

- Experience designing and maintaining platform APIs and the services behind them, including connection lifecycle management and integration with other OS components.

- Proficiency in C++ for systems development, including concurrent programming, memory ownership, and resource lifetime management.

- Strong understanding of asynchronous systems, interprocess communication, and failure handling.

- Experience diagnosing complex connectivity issues using system traces, protocol captures, logs, and structured debugging.

a bit about the role

British Rowing (BR) is the national governing body of the sport of rowing. An important part of its role is dealing with safeguarding concerns and disciplinary matters as they arise. To that end, from time to time BR refers matters to independent Panels convened under the terms of its Safeguarding Regulations and Disciplinary Rules. BR wishes to recruit a collection of experienced, independent individuals available to be appointed to its Safeguarding Panels by the Case Management Group (CMG).

BR via the Safeguarding Committee are now seeking applications to join the Safeguarding Panel. Applications are sought from safeguarding professionals, legally qualified or suitably experienced individuals Safeguarding Panel. Whilst this recruitment focuses on the Safeguarding Panel, suitably qualified individuals may sit on both Panels.

a bit about you

Responsibilities
Three person, independent Panels will be asked to sit on cases which arise inside of rowing. Cases based on behaviours outside of rowing are related to safeguarding and transferable risk. The key skills required of Panel members are set out below, however full training will be provided prior to sitting on any panels and ongoing training is also offered.

BR’s Regulations and Rules determine that all Panels must be chaired by a suitably legally qualified individual and that a Written Judgment be produced by the Panel on conclusion of the case. Current case load indicates that Panel members would need to provide availability for four to six Panels a year and members are asked to sit on cases on an ad hoc basis. A degree of flexibility is therefore required. Please note this is a voluntary role and as such there is no remuneration.

Person Specifications

• A nationally recognised professional qualification requiring expertise and skills in the safeguarding of children or adults at risk, and/or management of offenders; and/or

• A minimum of five years’ experience of working in a safeguarding role

• Recent experience of sitting on safeguarding tribunals, panels or case management groups which have powers to decide on the suitability of individuals to work with children, young people, and adults at risk;

• Recent experience of undertaking safeguarding risk assessments of individuals’ suitability to work with children, young people and adults at risk;

• A basic knowledge of employment law and other relevant legislation which concerns equality, disability discrimination, human rights law, and the safeguarding of children young people and adults at risk;

• An understanding and appreciation of the impact which abusive or discriminatory behaviour can have on children and young people including the additional vulnerability to abuse and exploitation of some young people;

• An understanding and appreciation of behaviour which is indicative of ‘grooming’ with the intention to abuse or exploit a child or young person;

• An understanding and appreciation of the support required for vulnerable witnesses and those accused of unsafe practice in work with children, young people and adults at risk;

• Ability to work alongside other professionals;

• Ability to assess and analyse a variety of evidence both written and in other forms;

• Knowledge of best practice in conducting disciplinary proceedings and in particular those of sports governing bodies.

• It is desirable that candidates have recent experience of chairing tribunals, panels or case management groups which have powers to decide on the suitability of individuals to work with children, young people or vulnerable adults.

mandatory requirements

• Applications will also be measured against current and potential needs of the Panel so as to fill gaps in experience and/or to meet diversity requirements.

title: Trade Support Senior - Remoto - Com Inglês
description:
SOBRE A CAPCO 

A Capco é uma consultoria global de tecnologia e negócios, focada no setor de serviços financeiros e energia, somos apaixonados por ajudar nossos clientes, temos 40 escritórios nas Américas, Europa e Ásia-Pacífico! Se criatividade e inovação são sua paixão, a Capco é ideal para você. Vamos te apoiar e ajudar a acelerar sua carreira!

 

A equipe Offshore de Trade Support é responsável pela execução de processos ponta a ponta (end-to-end) de suporte a operações para produtos de Bonds (títulos de dívida) e Term Loans (empréstimos a prazo) nos mercados dos Estados Unidos e EMEA (Europa, Oriente Médio e África) .

A equipe oferece suporte às funções de Middle Office e Back Office onshore , realizando atividades como registro das operações ( trade booking ), confirmação, preparação para liquidação ( settlement ) e atividades pós-liquidação, de acordo com procedimentos documentados, acordos de nível de serviço ( SLAs ) e padrões internos de controle.

As atividades de liquidação são realizadas por meio das principais infraestruturas de clearing e settlement do mercado, incluindo DTC, FED, Euroclear, CEDEL e ClearPar (para Term Loans).

A equipe offshore desempenha um papel fundamental para garantir a execução correta das operações do dia a dia, além de identificar e escalar exceções, riscos e violações para as equipes onshore de Trade Support e liderança de Operações dentro dos prazos adequados.

A equipe também é responsável por atividades específicas de pós-liquidação, incluindo investigação de operações que não foram liquidadas ( failed trades ), processamento de claims e conciliação de confirmações, com foco na redução do risco de liquidação e no aumento das taxas de processamento automatizado ( Straight-Through Processing - STP ).

Descrição da Vaga

• Executar os processos de Trade Support atribuídos de acordo com os procedimentos aprovados, frameworks de controle e SLAs estabelecidos no modelo operacional offshore.

• Realizar o registro ( trade booking ), confirmação e preparação para liquidação de operações com Bonds e Term Loans , utilizando infraestruturas como DTC, Euroclear, FED e ClearPar .

• Garantir que as operações sejam registradas de forma correta, completa e dentro dos prazos acordados nos sistemas relevantes.

• Confirmar as operações com as contrapartes de acordo com os padrões de mercado e as diretrizes internas.

• Em TD+0 / TD+1 , garantir que as operações estejam conciliadas ( matched ), com os recursos financeiros necessários ( funded ) e prontas para liquidação na data de valor.

• Monitorar o status das liquidações e identificar proativamente possíveis problemas, escalando riscos e atrasos para as equipes onshore quando necessário.

• Investigar e solucionar divergências nas operações ( trade breaks ), escalando exceções não resolvidas para os stakeholders apropriados.

• Apoiar a gestão de operações não liquidadas ( failed trades ) e o processamento de claims, garantindo acompanhamento dentro dos prazos e manutenção adequada dos registros.

• Realizar o registro e a liquidação de operações de Repo (Repurchase Agreement) .

• Executar controles diários, reconciliações e validações de checklists para garantir a conformidade com os requisitos internos de controle.

• Monitorar relatórios de exceções dos sistemas, filas de erros e estações/filas de tarefas, garantindo correção ou escalonamento dentro dos prazos adequados.

• Interpretar e processar mensagens SWIFT de liquidação (MT540-MT548) para garantir fluxos de settlement corretos.

• Cumprir os requisitos regulatórios e de reporting aplicáveis, como EMIR, MiFID e SEC , conforme definidos dentro do escopo de atuação da operação offshore.

• Manter comunicação clara e ágil com as equipes onshore de Trade Support, Front Office , custodiantes, brokers e equipes de tecnologia.

• Participar de iniciativas de melhoria de processos, padronização e automação, visando aumentar a eficiência e reduzir riscos operacionais.

This is not a support role. You own the architecture conversation, the proof-of-concept, and the depth of the customer relationship. Account teams partner with you - the technical trust is yours to build.
What You'll Actually Do

• Own the technical relationship. Be the person CTOs, platform teams, and infrastructure leaders trust for a straight answer - not just the one who runs the demo.

• Architect real solutions. Translate a customer's constraints - regulatory, operational, organizational - into deployable architecture across our Container, OpenStack, and Enterprise AI offerings.

• Lead the proof. Run PoCs that prove fit under real conditions: deploy the platform, prototype AI workloads, debug live, and show what running it operationally actually looks like.

• Tell the story. Turn infrastructure complexity into a narrative a CIO and a platform engineer can each act on - in a boardroom, a workshop, or on a whiteboard.

• Build and protect the account. Carry technical continuity from discovery through PoC through expansion - especially in regulated environments where trust is earned slowly and lost fast.

• Win net-new. Bring the same credibility to greenfield opportunities across regulated verticals, where the AI infrastructure conversation is often just starting.

• Shape what we build. Feed field insight back into product and GTM as our Enterprise AI infrastructure evolves - your input carries real weight.

Who You Are

• You've lived the cloud native rise. Kubernetes, containers, OpenStack, platform engineering - you've built and operated this, likely as a platform engineer, DevOps engineer, or cloud architect, before moving toward the customer.

• You're pulled toward AI infrastructure. GPU orchestration, inferencing, model serving - you're already leaning in, not waiting to be asked.

• You think in platforms, not tools. Compute, networking, storage, and now inference and governance - one architecture, not a checklist.

• You can deploy what you sell. You stand up clusters, run live demos, build PoCs, and debug them yourself when something breaks in front of the customer.

• You own relationships, not tickets. You've managed accounts in regulated, high-scrutiny environments and know that technical trust is the actual sales cycle.

• You're a natural technical evangelist. Conference talks, open-source contributions, technical writing, demo-building - this is already how you show up.

What Actually Matters Most
Driving demonstrable outcomes and results is what we care about most. We want someone with a proven track record of leading technical evaluations that turn into signed deals - and who can tell you exactly how they did it.
Equally important: proven technical authority in regulated enterprise

title: Principal Architect, Security Operations
description:
Bring more to life.

At Danaher , our work saves lives. And each of us plays a part. Fueled by our culture of continuous improvement, we turn ideas into impact - innovating at the speed of life. 

 

Our 60,000+ associates work across the globe at more than 15 unique businesses within life sciences, diagnostics, and biotechnology.  

 

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference? At Danaher , you can build an incredible career at a leading science and technology company, where we’re committed to hiring and developing from within. You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. 

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

At Danaher , the Principal Architect, Security Operations owns the enterprise architecture and reference designs for the Security Operations technology stack. This role defines how the technology enabling security data collection and retention, detection engineering, investigation workflows, automation, and response technologies are designed and integrated across the enterprise, including security data pipelines, data lakes, SIEM, SOAR, solution-integrated AI, and custom-built MCP architectures. The Principal Architect works independently as a functional expert across the Security Operations Center, other Danaher Information Security functions, enterprise and OpCo-level technology teams, and strategic vendors to solve complex problems with broad enterprise impact and to enable scalable, automated, and measurable security operations.

This position reports to Danaher ’s Security Operations leadershipand is part of the enterprise-wide Danaher Information Security (DIS) team. The position is remote.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

• Own end-to-end technology architecture and reference designs for the Security Operations technology stack, including security data pipelines, data lakes, SIEM, SOAR, solution-integrated AI, and custom MCP architectures.

• Establish and maintain integration patterns and architecture designs for cyber technologies, such as CrowdStrike, and non-cyber technologies that enable data enrichment, investigations, and automated response.

• Define enterprise detection, logging, and telemetry standards that improve visibility, analytics, investigation quality, and response consistency across Danaher .

• Evaluate, select, and guide implementation of security technologies and services that enhance detection, response, automation, and measurable operational outcomes.

• Lead architecture alignment across Security Operations, Cyber Defense, infrastructure, cloud, identity, data, and vendor teams to ensure scalable, supportable, and secure designs.

The essential requirements of the job include:

• 12+ years of experience in cybersecurity, security architecture, security engineering, security operations, detection engineering, incident response, or related technology roles.

• Experience designing or governing enterprise security operations technology architectures, including SIEM, SOAR, endpoint detection and response, cloud security telemetry, security data pipelines, or security data lakes.

• Experience establishing integration patterns across cyber and enterprise technology platforms using APIs, event streaming, data enrichment, orchestration, or automated response workflows.

• Experience defining detection, logging, telemetry, or security data standards for enterprise-scale environments.

• Ability to travel around 25%, overnight, within territory or other Danaher locations.

It would be a plus if you also possessprevious experience in:

• Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field.

• Experience with CrowdStrike, Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, Google SecOps, ServiceNow SecOps, Palo Alto Cortex XSOAR, or comparable enterprise security

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, AI Systems
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

As a Forward Deployed Engineer on the Systems Product Management team, you will build the intelligence layer behind Everpure's FlashArray and FlashBlade roadmap decisions. Our platforms generate an extraordinary volume of signal-fleet telemetry from tens of thousands of deployed systems alongside commercial, support, and cost data. Working directly with product managers across the portfolio, you will translate complex, cross-system questions into engineering solutions-leveraging applied AI and fleet-scale data engineering to build production systems that directly shape the hardware we ship.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

•
Own Engagements End-to-End : Partner directly with product managers to scope ambiguous business questions and carry them from discovery through to a solution running in production.

•
Design and Build the Platform : Deliver end-to-end capabilities, spanning data and orchestration layers through to the interfaces product managers actively use.

•
Build for Trust : Maintain high engineering standards so product managers can confidently stake critical roadmap decisions on system output.

•
Turn One-Offs into Capability : Convert bespoke, hard-won analyses into durable platform capabilities that continuously expand self-service intelligence.

•
Strengthen the Data Foundation : Identify gaps where existing data cannot answer strategic questions, partnering with data owners across the organization to close them.

WHAT YOU BRING

•
Production Engineering Craft : Strong, hands-on Python experience designing, building, and operating software in production-including HTTP APIs, relational schema design and migrations, containerized cloud deployments, version control, CI/CD, testing discipline, and frontend capability to build usable interfaces.

•
Data Judgment at Scale : Advanced SQL proficiency with large analytical datasets (e.g., Snowflake) and the business acumen to evaluate data integrity, understanding which strategic questions data can accurately answer.

•
Applied AI Experience : Proven experience shipping LLM-backed or agentic systems to real users, combined with rigorous evaluation practices that maintain system integrity as it evolves.

•
Communication and Influence : Ability to collaborate with non-technical stakeholders to define tractable engineering problems, exercise technical judgment, and communicate system readiness with credibility.

•
Location : We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Santa Clara, CA office in compliance with Everpure’s policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.

title: Mission Engineer II - Saratoga
locationText: New York, New York, United States
description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

This isn't a relationship management role. It's an ownership role. Sharp. Adaptable. Unstoppable. As a Mission Engineer II, you'll work directly alongside public safety agencies to turn real operational challenges into working technical solutions.

You'll spend time with the people doing the work, understand how the agency operates, identify problems worth solving, and use Axon tools, AI, automation, data, and the broader Axon ecosystem to build against them. 

Building is the core of the role, but customer needs come first. Because you're embedded with the agency, you'll also become a go-to technical resource who understands their Axon environment and helps them navigate critical needs when they arise. You may help quarterback an upcoming deployment, coordinate a complex technical issue, or connect the right Axon teams around an agency priority.

You won't replace Support, Deployment, Product, or other teams. You'll bring technical continuity, help connect the dots, and use what you learn to identify the next opportunity to build something better. Mission Engineers don't measure success by activity. They measure it by what gets built, what gets used, and what changes because of it.

What You’ll Do

Location: On Site with travel
Reports To: Manager or Senior Manager of Mission Engineering

Discover the Mission

• Embed with assigned agencies to understand their mission, people, workflows, systems, and priorities.

• Develop broad knowledge of the Axon ecosystem and deeper expertise in the products deployed at your agency.

• Work with frontline users, technical teams, and agency leadership to uncover operational friction.

• Translate customer problems into clear technical requirements and measurable success criteria.

• Identify opportunities for AI, automation, data, and Axon capabilities to improve how the agency operates.

• Understand what the customer needs-not simply what they initially ask for.

Build With the Platform

• Build applications, dashboards, workflows, automations, and using Axon products and other approved Axon tools.

• Apply foundational software engineering concepts including APIs, data structures, scripting, testing, debugging, and version control.

• Use AI and AI-assisted development tools responsibly within Axon's approved development and security environment.

• Configure and extend capabilities across Axon's technology ecosystem.

• Understand when you can solve the problem yourself and when deeper Product or Engineering partnership is required.

• Build with Axon-not around it.

Transform Builds Into Outcomes

• Move solutions from discovery into real customer use.

• Test and iterate alongside the people who will actually use what you build.

• Drive adoption and measure results against agreed success criteria.

• Continue improving solutions until they create sustained operational value.

• Document successful solutions so they can be maintained, improved, and reused.

Be the Agency's Go-To Technical Resource

• Maintain a consistent onsite presence and deep understanding of the agency's Axon environment.

• Lean into critical customer needs when your technical context or involvement can materially improve the outcome.

• Help quarterback technical alignment around important deployments without replacing the teams responsible for deployment execution.

• Serve as a liaison when complex technical issues require coordination

title: Nurse Practitioner - California (CA) License (Remote, Half-Time)
description:
Nurse Practitioner
Integrated Women’s Care (IWC) Employment Type: Full-Time
FLSA Status: Exempt
Compensation: $55 - $75 / hour, based on geographic location
Reports To: Nurse Practitioner Manager
Work Location: Remote - work must be completed within the United States
Schedule: Between 7:00 am - 7:00 pm, patient local timezone
You built your career caring for women at a time when the healthcare system largely ignored them. You know HRT, you understand the complexity of perimenopause, and you’ve spent years earning the clinical instincts it takes to actually get this right. Now you want to do it at scale - for more patients, with fewer barriers, and in a practice model that matches how you already think and work.
That’s what Midi is. A fully virtual, fast-paced clinical environment built specifically around women’s midlife health - and designed for NPs who are ready to practice at their best.
THE ROLE
You’ll carry a full patient panel, managing perimenopause, menopause, weight, sexual health, mood, and sleep - all virtually. This is ongoing, relationship-based care, which means your patients come back to you - visit after visit, over months and years. You’ll prescribe and independently manage HRT (estrogen, progesterone, testosterone), evaluate patients for pharmacologic weight management including GLP-1 therapies, and make autonomous clinical decisions every day.
It’s a high-volume environment. Documentation, follow-through, and productivity benchmarks are part of the job - and the NPs who thrive here don’t fight that reality, they’re built for it. About us
All Your BI is a remote-first data agency based in Rotterdam. Since 2019 we've grown from a boutique consultancy into an international data team of more than 60 data heroes spread across Europe. We deliver managed BI services for logistics and industrial companies, helping reduce data waste and move businesses forward. Serious fun.
What the job looks like

• Build and maintain end-to-end pipelines in the Azure stack, ingesting source data into the Data Lake and Azure SQL, orchestrated with Azure Data Factory.

• Develop the data warehouse layers from raw staging through the Data Vault and Business Vault into the dimensional Data Mart, primarily in T-SQL.

• Model data correctly, designing hubs, links and satellites in the vault, and conformed facts and dimensions in the mart.

• Investigate and understand source systems (e.g. terminal operating and maintenance systems) so the model reflects what the data really means, not just its shape.

• You'll work in with T-SQL · Azure (Data Factory, Data Lake Storage Gen2, Azure SQL) · Power BI · Git - plus Data Vault and dimensional modelling.

Requirements
What you bring

• ~5+ years hands-on , across data engineering and database development. We weight depth and range over the exact number, but this isn't a junior seat; you've owned real warehouse work, not just touched it.

• Real relational-database depth: you model in 3NF, read an execution plan, tune a slow query, and work confidently in the Data Vault layer beneath the mart, not just the semantic layer on top.

• Excellent T-SQL: especially stored procedures for transformation and loading.

• Hands-on Azure data engineering: you've built end-to-end pipelines with ADF, Data Lake Gen2 and Azure SQL.

• You build in Power BI, not just consume it: datasets/semantic models, relationships, DAX, reports.

• A reliability habit: data quality validated and monitored as part of the work, Git as a default, and the confidence to trace a broken pipeline/proc/DB project to root cause and fix it calmly.

title: Help Desk Specialist – Tier 1
description:
Overview
DecisionPoint seeks multiple Help Desk Specialists (Tier 1) to provide frontline IT customer support in a large federal and DoD-aligned service environment. These entry-level positions serve as the first point of contact for end users, providing assistance with password resets, account provisioning, multi-factor authentication, single sign-on support, and basic troubleshooting of user issues.
Tier 1 Help Desk Specialists are responsible for ticket triage, incident logging, clear communication with users, and accurate escalation to Tier 2 and Tier 3 teams when necessary. These roles help ensure a smooth, responsive, and customer-focused support experience for all end users.
This position is fully remote.
Duties & Responsibilities
The Help Desk Specialist - Tier 1 will:

• Serve as the first point of contact for end users via phone, chat, and service portal.

• Provide support for password resets, SSO troubleshooting, MFA challenges, and account access issues.

• Assist with account provisioning, basic role assignment questions, and user onboarding IT tasks.

• Triage incoming tickets, gather required information, and document incidents clearly in the ITSM system.

• Perform basic troubleshooting for workstations, applications, and connectivity issues.

• Follow established SOPs, scripts, and troubleshooting guidance for consistent service delivery.

• Escalate issues to Tier 2 or specialized teams when resolution requires advanced support.

• Track and manage assigned tickets to ensure timely response and SLA adherence.

• Communicate clearly and professionally with end users, providing updates and instructions as needed.

• Participate in user experience improvement initiatives, identifying recurring issues and reporting trends.

• Support shift handoffs, daily status updates, and knowledge sharing with the team.

• Maintain awareness of secure IT support practices appropriate for federal environments.
Qualifications
Clearance Requirement
Must hold an active Secret clearance, supported by a Tier 3 background investigation.
Education (Required)
High School Diploma or equivalent.
Experience (Required)

•
0-2 years of IT help desk, customer support, or service desk experience.

• Experience handling user service requests, technical inquiries, or customer-focused ticketing operations.

• Experience using ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow, Remedy, Jira Service Management) is preferred but not required.
Technical Knowledge (Required)

• Basic understanding of user account management, passwords, and authentication workflows.

• Familiarity with common end user issues involving email, device login, browser access, and workstation basics.

• Ability to follow scripts, troubleshooting guides, and SOP-driven processes.
Technical Knowledge (Preferred)

• Experience supporting SSO or MFA technologies.

• Familiarity with secure IT support procedures in federal or DoD-aligned environments.
Certifications

Preferred:

• ITIL v4 Foundation

• CompTIA A+

• CompTIA Security+ (helpful but not required)
Skills

• Strong customer service and communication skills.

• Ability to remain patient and professional under pressure.

• Strong attention to detail and accuracy in ticket documentation.

• Ability to follow structured troubleshooting workflows.

• Willingness to learn new tools, technologies, and processes.

• Ability to work within a fast-paced, SLA-driven support environment.
